newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FIGHTER JET CRASHES KILLING CREW - AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FIGHTER JET CRASHES KILLING CREW - AGENCY.

text.p: A Czech army MiG-23 fighter aircraft crashed while training in the southeastern part of the country on Tuesday killing its two-man crew, the local news agency CTK reported, quoting a defence ministry source.
A cause for the crash has not yet been given.

The Soviet-made jet crashed on Tuesday afternoon between the villages of Heralec and Darko, about 120 km (75 miles) southeast of the capital Prague, CTK said, but there were no reports of injuries on the ground.
Czech military officials were not immediately available for further comment.
The crash was the Czech army's second jet to go down in three weeks. A Soviet-made Su-22 M4 fighter/bomber crashed and killed the pilot on a training run on November 1.
